name: transmit the predictor coefficients and the residual
mechanism: fit a short linear predictor of each sample from its predecessors over a frame, transmit the coefficients and a coarse description of the prediction residual, and let the receiver run the predictor to reconstruct

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Linear predictive coding (LPC)' in section Information theory and signal processing / Coding theory / Lossy compression algorithms: lossy compression by representing the spectral envelope of a digital signal of speech in compressed form
List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Code-excited linear prediction (CELP)': low bit-rate speech compression

requires: a frame length and predictor order (policy)
